=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19194-19199 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed `repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}` read leaves `_STALL_STANDALONE_DEFAULT_BRANCH` empty and the failure is not recorded, so every later merged-PR candidate with a known base repeats the read.
  WHY: The header comment and changelog say at most one read per poller process. During an outage the read runs once per candidate with `gh_retry` backoff. The cost is small and the behaviour is fail-open. A flag such as `_STALL_STANDALONE_DEFAULT_BRANCH_TRIED=1` would make the claim true.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:final `STALL_SKIP ... reason=merged_non_target_base` branch | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: A non-`ai:check-triage` standalone issue whose PR merged into a non-target branch gets no label and no alert, only a log line each tick.
  WHY: It does not fail. This is the intended behaviour and the changelog tells operators to close such issues by hand. It is not a regression, so the reviewer did not raise it.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, `_reconcile_standalone_merged_pr_issue` default-branch lookup block. Add a "lookup attempted" flag and skip the read when it is set (about 3 lines changed). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

  PROBLEM: Failed default-branch lookups are not memoized.
  WHY: When `gh_retry` fails, `_STALL_STANDALONE_DEFAULT_BRANCH` stays empty and each later merged-PR candidate with a known base repeats the `repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}` call. This exceeds the documented one read per poller process and raises API usage during outages.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19194-19201 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When the default-branch lookup fails, `_STALL_STANDALONE_DEFAULT_BRANCH` is set to the empty string (the `|| echo ""` fallback plus the `null` check on line 19200). The next call re-enters the guard on line 19194 and re-issues the API call, so N candidates can cause up to N reads instead of the documented one per process.
  WHY: Under an API outage every merged-linked-PR candidate retries the failing read. The per-call behaviour is still correct (fallback to tagging `ai:merged`), but the ceiling holds only on a successful lookup. A sentinel such as `_STALL_STANDALONE_DEFAULT_BRANCH="__unavailable__"` would let later calls skip the lookup and fall through the line-19202 guard.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
